_comment: Reverse-WHOIS purchase gate for the harness `reverse_whois` tool (harness/tools.py:_reverse_gate). Every reverse-WHOIS starts with a free mode=preview count. If the count is above rwhois_auto_cap, the term is treated as a shared reseller, agency or registrar term (noise, not one operator) and the purchase does not happen until the caller re-calls with confirm=true. A per-call max_domains argument still overrides this default. Lower the value to spend fewer WhoisXML credits without asking; raise it if your cases routinely hold large single-operator estates. The value is read on every call, so an edit applies to the next decision.

rwhois_auto_cap._comment: Largest preview count that is purchased automatically (a count equal to the cap is still bought; anything above it asks first). Integer. Embedded fallback: 150.
